title: solutions-pro-services-weekly-sync-notes-2026-06-02
content:
Weekly sync notes: Solutions Engineering + Pro Services - 2026-06-02

Attendees: Aisha (notes), Evan, Priya, Liam, Marisol, Alex (sales), Noor (SRE)

Agenda:
- Quick wins / escalations
- Customer integration status (top 6)
- Blockers requiring eng/SRE support
- Demos / next milestones / rollout windows

Highlights / decisions:
- Agreed to move FinFlow to a phased rollout (canary -> 50% -> full) to avoid token price surprises. Sales signed for Dedicated reserve; contract goes live next Tuesday.
- HealthCo private deployment: schedule for Friday cutover to customer VPC; SRE to validate KMS integration on Thursday.
- Acme Corp POC: keep on hosted API for now, but enable prefix caching to meet latency SLOs; Solutions team to push config patch by EOD Thu.

Customer-by-customer status:
1) FinFlow (financial analytics)
- Current phase: Pre-production validation on Dedicated cluster
- Progress: model variant tested (quantized v2), throughput at target with batch_size=8 in p95 latency <= 220ms
- Blockers: observed tail latency spikes under concurrent job bursts. Linked JIRA: JIRA-PROJ-4821
- Owner: Evan
- Next steps: SRE to run stress test Wed (Noor), engineering to add KV cache instrumentation (PR #214)

2) HealthCo (HIPAA-regulated customer)
- Current phase: Private deployment (VPC + HSM KMS)
- Progress: infra terraform modules finalized; HSM smoke tests passed in staging
- Blockers: KMS rotation policy failing in customer's staging account due to policy scoping. Action: Priya to work with customer security to tweak role trust by Thu
- Owner: Priya
- Next steps: Final cutover planned for Fri 2026-06-05, SRE standby 09:00-17:00 PST

3) Acme Corp (e-commerce search)
- Current phase: Hosted API POC -> target production in 3 weeks
- Progress: prefix caching enabled for top 50 routes; token usage dropped ~18% in last 48h
- Blockers: two failing regression prompts surfaced in eval suite (CONFLUENCE-3789). Solutions to triage quality change by Mon 2026-06-08
- Owner: Liam
- Next steps: schedule customer demo for Tue 2026-06-09

4) RetailX (omnichannel retail)
- Current phase: onboarding, embedding pipeline setup
- Progress: embedding ingestion job benchmarked; throughput acceptable but memory spikes observed on 4GB nodes
- Blockers: memory tuning required for embedding batcher; linked to JIRA-PROJ-4872
- Owner: Marisol
- Next steps: infra to test 8GB spot nodes as stopgap; plan for dedicated pooling in Q3

5) AtlasBio (life sciences)
- Current phase: eval / security review ongoing
- Progress: NDA signed; initial data flows validated in staging with PII redaction hooks
- Blockers: compliance needs additional audit logs retention (customer asks 90 days vs our default 30d). Product to propose retention tier pricing
- Owner: Aisha

6) HelixMedia (ad-tech)
- Current phase: performance tuning (low-latency emphasis)
- Progress: switched to optimized kernels with sequence-length bucketing; p50 latency improved 35%
- Blockers: intermittent GPU OOM on 4096 token sequences; engineering to add input size guardrails and fallback truncation
- Owner: Alex (sales) / Evan

Open blockers requiring immediate attention:
- Tail latency spikes on FinFlow during concurrent burst loads -> SRE + serving-runtime to investigate (priority: high).
- KMS rotation policy for HealthCo staging -> security + infra to provide emergency patch by Thu.
- Embedding memory spikes for RetailX -> infra to test larger nodes and report by Fri.

Action items (owners & deadlines):
- Evan: Submit stress-test results + flamegraphs (Wed 2026-06-03)
- Priya: Complete KMS role adjustment with customer (Thu 2026-06-04)
- Liam: Triage eval regression prompts and open follow-up tickets (Mon 2026-06-08)
- Marisol: Run embedding memory tests on 8GB nodes and share numbers (Fri 2026-06-05)
- Aisha: Draft customer-facing rollout notes for FinFlow canary plan (Mon 2026-06-08)
- Noor (SRE): Standby for HealthCo cutover Fri 2026-06-05 09:00 PST

Risks / notes:
- Need clearer SLA expectations for Dedicated vs Hosted for customers moving to production; product to draft a one-pager (Aisha + product).
- Watch for token-usage surprises post-quantization changes; Solutions team to add a simple cost-check to the rollout checklist.

Meeting cadence / next sync:
- Weekly same time Tue 09:30 PST. Next meeting: 2026-06-09.
- Interim touchpoints: Ad-hoc warroom for FinFlow if stress-test shows p95 > 400ms.

Misc / notes to self (informal):
- Demo script for Acme: shorten to 10 minutes (focus on search latency + cost savings).
- Check with legal re: 90-day audit log ask from AtlasBio; may need a paid add-on.
- Follow up on PR #214 (infra) - contains KV cache instrumentation that helps explain FinFlow tail spikes.

Attachments / links: Confluence (CONFLUENCE-3789), JIRA (JIRA-PROJ-4821, JIRA-PROJ-4872), GH PR https://github.com/redwood-inference/infra/pull/214

End notes: keep items lightweight; call out any escalations in #sol-eng channel.
